crossRefs.note: Joshua and all Israel made as if they were beaten before them, and fled by the way of the wilderness.

people.name: Benjamin
people.line: Youngest son of Jacob and Rachel

people.name: Gibeah
people.line: A city of Benjamin, associated with Saul and atrocities.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: So the children of Benjamin saw that they were struck, for the men of Israel yielded to Benjamin because they trusted the ambushers whom they had set against Gibeah.
translations.bsb: Then the Benjamites realized they had been defeated. Now the men of Israel had retreated before Benjamin because they were relying on the ambush they had set against Gibeah.
translations.kjv: So the children of Benjamin saw that they were smitten: for the men of Israel gave place to the Benjamites, because they trusted unto the liers in wait which they had set beside Gibeah.
translations.asv: So the children of Benjamin saw that they were smitten; for the men of Israel gave place to Benjamin, because they trusted unto the liers-in-wait whom they had set against Gibeah.
